reason: I don't trust an AI with my money, and this is a brand I've never heard of with no reviews and no named broker yet. My robo-adviser already handles my paydays without a cartoon pet, so I'm not signing up for a paid real-money plan on a demo.
objection: An unknown startup's AI agent placing trades and making payments with my real paycheck, before there's a single review or a licensed broker I can actually name.
would_change_my_mind: The licensed broker partner being a name I already know, plus a solid pile of independent reviews from people using it with real money for a while.
